primaryReference.name: Campus daylight · university Mall / Scientia photograph
primaryReference.notes: Complete displayed university photograph visually inspected. Clear blue sky, warm sunlit masonry / pale paving, cooler shaded surfaces, dark tree shade and cyan glass guide a more neutral daylight balance. Article published 28 August 2026; photo capture date not verified from the filename. Lighting profiles are artistic fits, not a measured colour target, irradiance calibration or an exact solar time. Temporary Open Day banners, crowds and event objects are not added. Source pixels are linked only, not used as textures.

priorState.goldenReflection: Only background sky texture changed; initial daytime PMREM stayed assigned.
priorState.sunAnchor: Absolute world Y fixed at 155 / 65 while target followed terrain, causing the relative solar angle to change between elevations.

change.profiles: Separate illustrative daylight and golden-hour sun, sky fill, neutral ground bounce, fog and environment settings. Afternoon direction is northwest; profile angle is constant relative to each terrain anchor.
change.cache: Two sky / prefiltered environment pairs, created lazily per mode and reused on every subsequent toggle. Background and reflection resources always come from the same mode. Both textures / render targets, PMREM generator and shadow resources disposed on game destroy.
change.visualResult: Less green ambient tint under pale concrete. Stronger distinction between sunlit paving and tree shade, cooler daylight sky and warmer lower-angle golden hour. All geometry, mapped heights, raw terrain, paths and walk surfaces are untouched.
change.limitations: Photographs provide qualitative appearance evidence only. Profiles do not reproduce a surveyed solar position, date, exposure, weather condition or calibrated material albedo. No HDR photograph pixels or source media are redistributed.

browserVerification.comparison: Same Mathews pavilion entrance used for live-before / local-after daylight and golden-hour images. Courtyard arrival inspected in both profiles.
browserVerification.walking: Walked 4 m in Catherine Harris Courtyard after repeated mode toggles; ground remained 52.9 m.
browserVerification.modes: Repeated daylight / golden-hour changes work; no browser warnings or errors.

unitCoverage: Real Three.js scene/light classes with controlled PMREM allocation test doubles: constant sun direction across terrain elevations, matching sky/environment/lighting mode, at most two cached environment pairs, idempotent complete disposal, neutral lower-sky / bounce channels and shadow-anchor translation.

verification.native: Mathews entrance day / golden comparison; Catherine courtyard day / golden, repeated toggles and 4 m walk at 52.9 m elevation; no warnings or errors.
